positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: the LAST image provided is the guest photo. Count the people in it. The output must contain EXACTLY that many people — not one more, not one fewer. One person in the photo means one person alone in the output. Three people means exactly those three. Five means exactly those five. You are FORBIDDEN from inventing, adding, duplicating, cloning, mirroring or imagining any person who is not in that photo. Do not add anyone to balance the composition, fill empty space, fill the frame width, or make the group look bigger. If the people do not fill the frame, leave the remaining space to the environment — empty space is correct and expected. The grand architectural space behind and beside them is completely empty of other people — no extra staff, no bystanders, no faces in the distance.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed — nothing covers anyone's eyes, nose or mouth. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, closed-mouth smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: dress everyone in clean modern white food manufacturing technical PPE coats with sleek royal blue safety accents. Neat embroidered Garudafood logo on the left chest. Hairnet if worn sits well behind the hairline leaving full face visible. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain white, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing prescription glasses keeps them. No mask, no goggles.

BRAND MARK: the FIRST image provided is the Garudafood corporate logo. Reproduce it accurately as a neat embroidered crest on the left chest of every uniform, and printed cleanly on the shipping cartons in the far background.

PRODUCTS — COPY, DO NOT INVENT: real Garudafood snack packs (Gery, Garuda, Chocolatos, Okky) moving smoothly along the far automated conveyor line in the background. Reproduce pack artworks faithfully. Keep the foreground uncluttered.

SCENE: standing in an immense, cathedral-scale automated smart manufacturing plant. Gleaming reflective epoxy cleanroom floors stretch toward the distant horizon. Endless rows of precision robotic packaging lines, stainless steel machinery, and high-speed conveyor tracks recede into deep atmospheric perspective. Vast industrial grandeur of a high-tech smart factory.

FRAMING & HERO COMPOSITION — LARGE BOLD SCALE: Photographed at natural standing eye-level with a subtle, confident heroic angle (horizon level, not tilted, not a selfie).
- CROP: Crisp waist-up / upper-body crop (from belt/navel level upwards to just above the head). Legs, knees, and thighs are NOT in the frame. The heads are placed cleanly in the upper third of the frame, avoiding excessive empty headroom.
- GROUP SCALE (FOR 2 OR 3 PEOPLE): When 2 or more people are in the photo, they stand side-by-side confidently and naturally as professional corporate colleagues. Stand independently with clean posture and respectful spacing — ABSOLUTELY NO hugging, NO embracing, NO arms wrapped around shoulders or waists, NO romantic couple poses, NO holding hands. The subjects boldly and prominently fill the width of the frame — it is completely expected and encouraged for outer shoulders and arms to extend right to the frame edges, with a natural 5% to 10% crop at the left and right borders so that the people appear significantly larger, bolder, and more prominent in the frame rather than shrunk or distant.
- SINGLE SUBJECT: Bold, commanding upper-body presence filling the frame with prestige.
- Every face is large, clear, tack-sharp, and individually recognizable with natural warm expressions.

LIGHTING: dramatic industrial commercial lighting — overhead architectural light ribbons casting long clean reflections on the floor, warm accent glows on machinery, strong soft key light sculpting every face brightly, crisp rim light on shoulders.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic 40mm, f/2.0. Immense visual depth of field, sharp foreground subjects with majestic machinery bokeh behind. Realistic skin texture.

GRADE: premium cinematic industrial commercial grade — deep rich contrast, cool clean steel tones balanced with warm skin lighting. High resolution.

DO NOT: hugging, embracing, romantic couple poses, cuddling, arms wrapped around each other, holding hands, leaning heads together; add, duplicate or invent any person; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes, knees, thighs or a full-body view; camera positioned too far away; people appearing small or distant; render any invented text, slogan, price tag or signage wording — the only legible text allowed is the Garudafood wordmark; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces. NEVER add a person who is not in the guest photo — no extra colleague, no background figure, no duplicate of anyone, no reflection of a person; the people count must match the guest photo exactly.
video_positive_prompt: The people in the video look directly at the camera with big joyful smiles, actively raising their hands and waving enthusiastically in a friendly greeting (dadah-dadah hand wave). Lively hand waving motion, cheerful smiling expressions, natural eye blinking and head movement. Static tripod camera, fixed camera framing, no zoom, no camera movement. Keep exact same people, faces, hair, uniforms, clothing, and Garudafood brand logos perfectly consistent. Continuous seamless action throughout the entire video from the first second to the very end, constant bright lighting, no fade out, no fade to black, no black frames at the end, perfectly visible until the final frame. Immense cathedral-scale automated smart factory floor with gleaming conveyor lines, 4k cinematic commercial finish.
